user.title: Kinetic Voice Router
user.description: Adds the Kinetic Voice Router (version {version}) and connects it to your Hermes Agent Companion. The connection is tested before anything is saved. The router only handles requests that Home Assistant did not process locally and never controls devices. It starts in mode "Off". **Experimental software, no warranty.**

data_description.url: Address of the Hermes Agent Companion, e.g. http://host:8765 (LAN or VPN only; HTTPS recommended).
data_description.token: Token of the Hermes Companion. It is stored in the Home Assistant configuration and never shown or logged.
data_description.verify_tls: Keep enabled. Only disable for a self-signed certificate in a trusted network.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Hermes Companion
reauth_confirm.description: The connection to the Hermes Companion needs to be set up again (for example a rejected token, or an update from an older version). Enter URL and token; they are tested first.

connection.title: Hermes connection

speech_memory.title: Speech memory
speech_memory.description:
{overview}

Only confirmed pairs are stored (misheard word → meant word), never sentences, audio or conversation IDs. Device, room and control words are never learned or replaced.

speech_memory_unavailable.title: Speech memory
speech_memory_unavailable.description: The speech memory is only available while the integration is loaded (Hermes connection established).

speech_memory_toggle.title: Learn speech corrections
speech_memory_toggle.description: When on (and mode is Active), the router asks after a correction such as "No, I meant Mulan" whether to remember the pair, stores it only after an explicit "yes", and applies confirmed pairs to harmless conversation. Off by default.

speech_memory_add.title: Add a term
speech_memory_add.description: Enter what speech recognition hears and what you mean. 1–3 words each, letters only.

data_description.heard: e.g. Mulahn – at least 3 letters; single letters are not accepted.
data_description.category: Ambiguous terms are stored but never replaced automatically.

speech_memory_edit_entry.title: Edit term
speech_memory_edit_entry.description: Recognised as **{heard}**. Change the meaning or the category.

speech_memory_delete.title: Delete a term
speech_memory_delete.description: The selected term is deleted immediately.

speech_memory_reset_confirm.title: Reset speech memory?
speech_memory_reset_confirm.description: All learned and manually added terms are deleted. This also repairs a dictionary that could not be read. This cannot be undone.

test.title: Test request
test.description: Simulation – no device action, no Hermes call.

data_description.test_sentence: Only the router decision is checked, not whether Home Assistant would handle the sentence locally. The sentence is not stored.

reset_confirm.title: Reset counters?
reset_confirm.description: All runtime counters are set to 0. Mode and settings stay unchanged. This cannot be undone.

error.invalid_mode: Unknown mode. Choose Off, Observe or Active.
error.asm_invalid: Use 1–3 words with letters only (max. 40 characters).
error.asm_too_short: Too short: at least 3 letters are needed (single letters such as "T" are not accepted).
error.asm_same: Recognised and meant are the same.
error.asm_protected: Device, room, control and confirmation words cannot be learned.
error.asm_conflict: This term already has another meaning. Edit the existing entry instead.
error.asm_chain: This would create a chain or loop with an existing entry.
error.asm_full: The speech memory is full. Delete entries first.
error.asm_read_only: The stored dictionary is locked because it could not be read. Reset it first.

options.off: Off – Hermes works as without the router
options.active: Active – short router answer for device and status requests
